children: The Czech Republic’s current account deficit widened to CZK 34.2 billion in July 2026, from CZK 27.0 billion in July 2025.

The deterioration was mainly driven by a wider secondary income deficit, which increased to CZK 8.4 billion from CZK 6.4 billion, while the goods and services surplus narrowed to CZK 15.8 billion from CZK 22.0 billion.
Within this, the goods surplus fell to CZK 10.7 billion from CZK 11.9 billion, while the services surplus halved to CZK 5.1 billion from CZK 10.1 billion.
Meanwhile, the primary income deficit narrowed to CZK 41.6 billion from CZK 42.6 billion.

title: Czechia Current Account Deficit Widens in July
